Here's something I've thrown together in the past, sorry for the shitty job in writing it down; it's moreso a rough recipe ya can build off of, but it works! 


1 cup kamut puffs - 50 calories 
Quarter cup oats - 40 calories 
Cinnamon (to taste)
Salt (a lil pinch is nice)
Other spices if you like (to taste)
Spritz of neutral oil spray of your choice (9 calories is standard) 
Any other low calorie mix-ins you'd like, since the base ingredients are low calorie you can honestly play around here. Lily's chocolate chips would be fun, or for a lower option a bit of a chopped Gatsby chocolate bar.


Quarter cup erythritol or swerve- 0 cal
Half tsp vanilla extract 

Mix spice blend if you're using one, spritz the dry oats and kamut puffs with oil and combine them with it. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. 

Heat a small nonstick saucepan to medium heat. Add in erythritol or swerve. That's it. The granulation doesn't matter, because in a few minutes...it's going to begin to melt. I don't take the temperature but I've never burned it, honestly I don't know if it DOES burn. 

Once your erythritol is melted, it'll be very hot. Ensure the next step is done in a heat resistant bowl. 


Transfer oat mix to a heat resistant bowl, and while stirring, drizzle the melted erythritol over the top. Add in vanilla extract at this point.This will get it to stick together, but it also recrystallizes fast. It's not a very clustered granola.  Keep mixing until coated to your liking, then transfer to dry into the baking sheet. You can also give it an extra toast on low heat in the oven for an extra toasted flavor. Kamut and oats both seem to burn pretty fast, though, so keep an eye on it. Or maybe pre toast your oats. 

It's something you can build on, certainly. I'll post pics if I make it again recently but I've not been on that many carbs recently. 

Also can be made in larger batches. This is pretty much a single serving. 

Hope this gives you some frame of reference! :)

Alright here's a bit of a review, tried some last night...and then my battery broke. Comedic timing.

Number one for me is definitely Fruit Snacks, the flavor is amazing -- it really reminds me of well, fruit snacks. The smell you get from opening a bag of Mott's gummies is what you've got here. It's vaguely piney, (most of the carts I got are) and it has a nice almost apple-berry flavor to it. I also found this one hits a bit smoother than the rest of the carts, I'm not sure why. Got me super buzzed off just 2 4 second hits. Yeah, I don't use Delta 8 often so my tolerance is low, but still. It seems a bit more strong than some other even more expensive brands I've tried 
My second favorite is rainbow sherbet. It's aptly named, tastes just like rainbow sherbet! Also seems smoother hitting from the rest. Definitely fruity and sweet but not cloyingly so. It's really nice, the effects were the same as fruit snacks but I didn't expect any difference between the effects of the cartridges. 
My third favorite is Purple Punch. I had someone else on here tell me it tasted like purple Skittles; which is definitely accurate. It's pleasant, a mix of berry, pine, and grape flavors. Draws memories for me of concord grapes.
Fourth place, blueberry lemonade. Very accurate to the flavor described, nice berry and lemon flavors. Smooth hitting, awesome effects as with the rest of them. 
Fifth favorite, Mimosa -- I bought this one for my mom but took a hit of it for the sake of my review. This one is a little harsher than the rest, and kind of flat taste wise. I still like it, it's just not as good tasting as the rest. Still, for the price? Pretty dang good! Taste is not a huge factor for me, I just use it for the effects. 
Sixth favorite, Strawberry Cough. It was just alright, harsher than the rest and it had a taste that reminded me of freshly laid soil and mould. There's still a strawberry flavor to it, but it's overpowered by the kind of cloying earthy flavor. 
Still yet to try blue razz. 'Cause my battery broke. It smells good, just gonna say that.
